note: A basket or cart used to collect goods while shopping; in some places, a small hand-held basket.

senses.m: A basket or cart used to collect goods while shopping
senses.pat: put items in a shopping basket · carry a shopping basket · online shopping basket
ex: She put the apples in her shopping basket.
Cô đặt táo vào giỏ mua hàng.
The online shopping basket saves items before checkout.
Giỏ hàng trực tuyến lưu các món trước khi thanh toán.

note: To support or strengthen something physically or figuratively.

senses.m: To support or strengthen something physically or figuratively
senses.pat: shore up a wall · shore up support · shore something up
ex: Workers shored up the wall before the storm.
Công nhân gia cố bức tường trước cơn bão.
The company raised funds to shore up its finances.
Công ty huy động vốn để củng cố tình hình tài chính.

note: A tendency to become angry quickly; also short-tempered as an adjective.

senses.m: A tendency to become angry quickly
senses.pat: have a short temper · lose one’s temper quickly · short-tempered person
ex: He has a short temper when he is tired.
Anh dễ nóng giận khi mệt mỏi.
Her short-tempered response surprised the team.
Phản ứng nóng nảy của cô khiến cả nhóm bất ngờ.

note: A radio wavelength in the high-frequency band, used for long-distance broadcasts; also shortwave.

senses.m: A radio wavelength in the high-frequency band, used for long-distance broadcasts
senses.pat: short-wave radio · listen on short wave · short-wave broadcast
ex: They listened to the news on a short-wave radio.
Họ nghe tin tức bằng radio sóng ngắn.
Shortwave signals can travel long distances.
Tín hiệu sóng ngắn có thể truyền đi xa.

note: A bag carried by a strap over one shoulder; styles include handbags, satchels, and messenger bags.

senses.m: A bag carried by a strap over one shoulder
senses.pat: carry a shoulder bag · a leather shoulder bag · wear a bag over one shoulder
ex: She carried a small shoulder bag on the train.
Cô mang một chiếc túi đeo vai nhỏ trên tàu.
The shoulder bag has an adjustable strap.
Túi đeo vai có dây đeo điều chỉnh được.

note: One of the two flat triangular bones at the back of the shoulder; anatomical term scapula.

senses.m: One of the two flat triangular bones at the back of the shoulder
senses.pat: pain near the shoulder blade · shoulder-blade movement · between the shoulder blades
ex: He felt a muscle strain near his shoulder blade.
Anh bị căng cơ gần xương bả vai.
The therapist worked on the muscles between her shoulder blades.
Chuyên viên trị liệu tác động lên các cơ giữa hai xương bả vai.

note: A severe headache accompanied by nausea or vomiting; British English, often used for migraine, though not every migraine includes vomiting.

senses.m: A severe headache accompanied by nausea or vomiting
senses.pat: suffer from sick headaches · a sick headache attack · get a sick headache
ex: She went home with a sick headache.
Cô về nhà vì bị đau đầu dữ dội kèm buồn nôn.
The doctor asked how often the sick headaches occurred.
Bác sĩ hỏi những cơn đau đầu kèm buồn nôn xảy ra thường xuyên thế nào.

note: A smaller dish served with the main course, such as vegetables or rice.

senses.m: A smaller dish served with the main course, such as vegetables or rice
senses.pat: order a side dish · serve as a side dish · a side dish of rice
ex: We ordered a side dish of grilled vegetables.
Chúng tôi gọi một món rau nướng ăn kèm.
The salad can be served as a side dish.
Món salad có thể dùng làm món ăn kèm.

note: A small two-headed drum played with sticks, carried at the side in marching bands; also called snare drum in many contexts.

senses.m: A small two-headed drum played with sticks, carried at the side in marching bands
senses.pat: play the side drum · a marching-band side drum · side-drum rhythm
ex: The drummer played a steady rhythm on the side drum.
Người chơi trống giữ nhịp đều trên trống snare.
The band’s side drum was carried on a sling.
Trống snare của ban nhạc được đeo bằng dây.

note: A piece of music associated with a particular person, program, or event; sometimes a theme song.

senses.m: A piece of music associated with a particular person, program, or event
senses.pat: a program’s signature tune · play one’s signature tune · opening signature tune
ex: The show’s signature tune is recognized by its first notes.
Nhạc hiệu của chương trình được nhận ra ngay từ những nốt đầu.
The pianist played her signature tune at the concert.
Nghệ sĩ piano chơi bản nhạc gắn liền với mình tại buổi hòa nhạc.

note: A medal awarded for second place in many competitions; medal rules vary by event.

senses.m: A medal awarded for second place in many competitions
senses.pat: win/receive a silver medal · silver-medal winner · Olympic silver medal
ex: She won a silver medal in the 400-meter race.
Cô giành huy chương bạc ở nội dung chạy 400 mét.
The silver-medal team celebrated with its supporters.
Đội giành huy chương bạc ăn mừng cùng người hâm mộ.

note: The cinema screen; figuratively, the film industry or movies, especially in older usage.

senses.m: The cinema screen
senses.pat: appear on the silver screen · a star of the silver screen · silver-screen legend
ex: The actor made her debut on the silver screen.
Nữ diễn viên lần đầu xuất hiện trên màn ảnh rộng.
The museum celebrates stars of the silver screen.
Bảo tàng tôn vinh các ngôi sao màn bạc.

note: A person or thing that is easy to attack, criticize, or take advantage of; informal.

senses.m: A person or thing that is easy to attack, criticize, or take advantage of
senses.pat: be a sitting duck · leave someone a sitting duck · an easy target
ex: Without cover, the vehicle was a sitting duck.
Không có chỗ che chắn, chiếc xe trở thành mục tiêu dễ bị tấn công.
The outdated system left the company a sitting duck for hackers.
Hệ thống lỗi thời khiến công ty thành mục tiêu dễ bị tin tặc tấn công.

note: A student in the sixth form, the final two years of secondary school in parts of the UK; term is British and system-specific.

senses.m: A student in the sixth form, the final two years of secondary school in parts of the UK
senses.pat: a sixth former at school · sixth-form students · become a sixth former
ex: The sixth former applied to universities across the country.
Học sinh năm cuối trung học nộp đơn vào các trường đại học trên cả nước.
The school held a careers event for sixth formers.
Trường tổ chức sự kiện hướng nghiệp cho học sinh lớp cuối cấp.

note: An intuitive feeling or ability to know something without conscious reasoning; not a scientifically established extra sense.

senses.m: An intuitive feeling or ability to know something without conscious reasoning
senses.pat: have a sixth sense about · trust one’s sixth sense · a sixth-sense feeling
ex: She had a sixth sense that something was wrong.
Cô có linh cảm rằng có điều gì đó không ổn.
He trusted his sixth sense and checked the door again.
Anh tin vào linh cảm của mình và kiểm tra cửa lần nữa.

note: A medicine used to help someone sleep; may cause side effects or dependence, so use only as directed by a clinician or label.

senses.m: A medicine used to help someone sleep
senses.pat: take a sleeping pill · sleeping-pill side effects · prescribed sleeping pills
ex: She took a sleeping pill only as prescribed.
Cô chỉ uống thuốc ngủ theo đúng chỉ định.
The pharmacist explained possible side effects of the sleeping pill.
Dược sĩ giải thích các tác dụng phụ có thể có của thuốc ngủ.

note: A manual calculating instrument with sliding logarithmic scales, used before electronic calculators became common.

senses.m: A manual calculating instrument with sliding logarithmic scales, used before electronic calculators became common
senses.pat: use a slide rule · calculate with a slide rule · a pocket slide rule
ex: The engineer used a slide rule to estimate the value.
Kỹ sư dùng thước tính để ước lượng giá trị.
The science museum displayed a slide rule from the 1950s.
Bảo tàng khoa học trưng bày một chiếc thước tính từ thập niên 1950.

note: A short road that allows vehicles to enter or leave a major road; British English, called an entrance/exit ramp in US English.

senses.m: A short road that allows vehicles to enter or leave a major road
senses.pat: join the motorway by a slip road · an exit slip road · leave via the slip road
ex: Use the slip road to join the motorway.
Dùng đường nhánh để nhập vào đường cao tốc.
The exit slip road was closed for repairs.
Đường nhánh lối ra bị đóng để sửa chữa.

note: To make a small mistake, often unintentionally.

senses.m: To make a small mistake, often unintentionally
senses.pat: slip up on a detail · make a slip-up · slip up once
ex: I slipped up and sent the draft to the wrong person.
Tôi sơ suất gửi bản nháp nhầm người.
The team cannot afford to slip up on the final check.
Nhóm không thể mắc sai sót ở bước kiểm tra cuối.

note: A lane for slower-moving traffic; figuratively, a less active or less successful position.

senses.m: A lane for slower-moving traffic
senses.pat: drive in the slow lane · move into the slow lane · be stuck in the slow lane
ex: Trucks should remain in the slow lane.
Xe tải nên đi ở làn đường chậm.
The business felt stuck in the slow lane while rivals expanded.
Doanh nghiệp cảm thấy bị tụt lại khi các đối thủ mở rộng.
